project_tracker_diagnostic: Tall annual with very large lavender-pink discoid heads and striking basket-like overlapping involucral bracts; older name Centaurea americana is still widely encountered.

project_inclusion.learning_reason: Common, conspicuous, or high-value comparison species for Central Texas field ID.

morphology_keys.leaves: Alternate, lanceolate to oblong-lanceolate, entire to toothed/lobed.
morphology_keys.heads: Large solitary lavender-pink heads made only of disc florets; outer florets enlarged and showy.
morphology_keys.phyllaries: Broadly overlapping, papery/fringed bracts create the distinctive basket appearance.

photo_strategy.selection_logic: Prefer curated taxon photos plus multiple views from one Central Texas/Texas observation.

taxonomy_note: Accepted as Plectocephalus americanus; Centaurea americana is a homotypic synonym.
